project.title: Launch of a Unified Retail Client Financial Advisory Program
project.objective: Design and roll out a standardized financial advisory program for retail clients, aligning planning, lending, and compliance across branches.
deliverables: Standardized client financial planning framework and templates
Segmented advisory playbooks for savings, credit, and protection needs
Branch rollout plan with training schedule and responsibilities
Compliance and tax-planning guidelines for advisors
KPI dashboard definition for monitoring program performance
constraints: Program must comply with current tax legislation and internal credit policies
Initial rollout limited to existing retail clients in two pilot regions
All client-facing materials must pass compliance review before use
Advisory process must be executable within standard appointment slots
Data used for dashboards must come from existing core systems only

risks.risk: Advisory framework conflicts with updated tax or lending regulations.
risks.mitigation: Involve compliance early, schedule a mid-project legal review, and lock a sign-off checkpoint before rollout.

risks.risk: Branch staff do not adopt the new advisory process consistently.
risks.mitigation: Provide concise playbooks, mandatory training, and simple KPIs tied to existing performance reviews.

risks.risk: Data needed for KPIs is incomplete or hard to extract from core systems.
risks.mitigation: Align KPI definitions with currently available fields and run a data availability check before finalizing metrics.

risks.risk: Client appointments exceed standard time slots due to added steps.
risks.mitigation: Pilot the process with time tracking, streamline questions, and define a light version for simple cases.

themes.why_relevant: Ensures all advisors follow a consistent, auditable process across branches.

themes.theme: Tax and regulatory compliance in client advice
themes.why_relevant: Advisory content must align with tax legislation and internal risk policies.
Different client profiles need tailored plans, credit, and protection solutions.
Employment and branch-facing roles must operationalize the new program.
KPIs and feedback loops are needed to refine the advisory program post-launch.

backlog.task: Define standardized client financial planning templates and data points
definition_of_done: Template covers income, expenses, assets, liabilities, and goals
Fields mapped to existing systems where possible
Reviewed and approved by accounting manager and financial manager

backlog.task: Draft tax and compliance guidelines for retail financial advice
definition_of_done: Guidelines cover tax planning boundaries and disclosure requirements
Reviewed by risk and compliance officer
Published in an accessible internal guideline document

backlog.task: Design client segmentation model and advisory playbooks
definition_of_done: Segments defined based on income, life stage, and risk profile
Playbooks created for at least three key segments
Playbooks validated with two pilot branches

backlog.task: Specify KPIs and reporting requirements for the advisory program
definition_of_done: KPI list agreed with stakeholders and limited to available data
Data sources and calculation logic documented
Handed over to IT reporting specialist via a requirements sheet

backlog.task: Create branch rollout and training plan for advisors
definition_of_done: Pilot branches and dates confirmed with branch managers
Training agenda and materials drafted
Attendance tracking approach defined

backlog.task: Develop client-facing summary materials for the advisory program
definition_of_done: One-page overview and FAQ created for clients
Language checked for clarity and compliance
Materials approved by marketing and compliance

backlog.task: Run process walk-through and time-box test of advisory session
definition_of_done: At least three mock sessions completed with advisors
Session duration recorded and bottlenecks identified
Improvement suggestions documented and shared

backlog.task: Align advisory program with loan and insurance product rules
definition_of_done: Mapping of advisory steps to eligible products completed
Constraints for business loans and insurance documented
Reviewed with risk and compliance officer

backlog.task: Define control checks and documentation standards for audits
definition_of_done: List of mandatory documents per client file defined
Sample file checklist created for advisors
Audit team confirms adequacy of controls

backlog.task: Prepare pilot evaluation criteria and feedback survey
definition_of_done: Success criteria for pilot branches documented
Advisor and client feedback forms drafted
Evaluation timeline agreed with stakeholders

backlog.task: Consolidate pilot results and propose adjustments
definition_of_done: Pilot KPIs and feedback summarized in a short report
Key issues and quick wins highlighted
Next-step recommendations agreed in project team

backlog.task: Update hiring and onboarding notes for new advisors
definition_of_done: Job briefing updated with new advisory program expectations
Onboarding checklist includes training on templates and playbooks
Shared with HR and branch managers

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, segments, and core advisory workflow for the new program.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the unified advisory program project and asking for scope confirmation.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final list of client segments to be covered in the initial rollout.
Confirm the high-level advisory workflow steps to standardize across branches.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock down tax, compliance, and documentation standards for advisors.
threads_plan.trigger: Accounting manager shares a draft of tax and compliance guidelines for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the tax and compliance guideline for use in the pilot branches.
Agree on the mandatory documents list for each client file.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define KPIs, data sources, and expectations for pilot performance tracking.
threads_plan.trigger: Financial controller posts a draft KPI and reporting specification for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the final KPI set to track during the pilot.
Confirm that all selected KPIs are feasible with current data sources.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and confirm the branch rollout, training sessions, and mock runs.
threads_plan.trigger: Employment agent shares the proposed rollout and training plan for comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm pilot branches and training dates for the advisory program.
Agree on the final training agenda and mock session approach.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot results and agree on adjustments before wider rollout.
threads_plan.trigger: Financial manager posts the pilot evaluation report and asks for go/no-go feedback.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in where each participant posts yesterday-today-blockers in one message.
Twice-weekly short planning thread to confirm priorities and owners for the next two days.
Weekly pilot readiness or progress review summarizing status against KPIs and risks.
Post-pilot retrospective thread focusing on what to keep, change, and drop before scale-up.
